# 1. Calving site selection

## 1.1 Initialization before analysis


Load the data set :

```{r}
data<-read.csv("data/CSV/data_cleaned_calving_RG.csv")
View(data)
```

Only the years 2008-2009-2010-2011-2015-2016 were studied, the years 2017 and 2018 were removed from the analysis:

```{r}
data<-data[-c(which(data$year==2017),which(data$year==2018)),]
data$year<-as.factor(data$year)
levels(data$year)

```

All the unnecessary columns were also removed.

```{r}
data<-data[,1:8]
```

The dates in the "timestamp" column were converted in another shape to use the "ltraj" function later on.

```{r}
data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(data$timestamp,"%Y-%m-%d T%H:%M:%SZ", tz="UTC")
```

Then the data was transform into animal trajectory using the "ltraj" function

```{r}
gps.data.ltraj <- as.ltraj(xy = data[, c("x", "y")], date = data$timestamp, 
                           id = data$id, burst = data$id, 
                           proj4string = CRS("+init=epsg:3006"))
length(gps.data.ltraj)
```



The column "ID" has to be ordered to use the "move" function to convert the data into a move object.

```{r}
data <- data[order(data$id),]

```

Conversion into a move object

```{r}
move.data <- move(x = data$x, y = data$y,
                  time = data$timestamp,
                  data = data, animal = data$id, sensor = 'GPS')
move.data

nrow(move.data@idData)
move.data@idData %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(row_number = row_number())

```

Then was created a new empty table that will be filled by the calving period and site coordinates determined in this analysis.

```{r}
calving_candidates <- data.frame(id = character(),
                                 x = numeric(), 
                                 y = numeric(), 
                                 date1 = POSIXct(), 
                                 date2 = POSIXct(), 
                                 year = numeric())



```

## 1.2 Re-visitation

To determine the calving time and so the calving site, was calculated the re-visitation in a radius of 200 m for all the individuals

So the following code on the "revisitation" part was repeated for each individual changing n from 1 to length(data)

n corresponds to the first individual then to the second...

```{r}
n<-1

radius <- 200
```

The move object for the individual n was extracted

```{r}
move.ind <- move.data[[n]]
```

### 1.2.1 Re-visitation analysis from recurse package :

```{r}
revisitation <- getRecursions(move.ind, radius = radius)

lab_dates <- move.ind$timestamp[seq(1, length(move.ind), length.out = 10)]

```

Creation of 2 graphs representing the trajectory of the individual n related to dates(g1) and to time spend in a spot (g2).

```{r}
g1 <- as(move.ind, 'data.frame') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, color = as.numeric(timestamp))) + 
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis(breaks = as.numeric(lab_dates), 
                      labels = as_date(lab_dates)) +
  labs(x = '', y = '', color = "Time") +
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(2.5, "cm"))

g2 <- as(move.ind, 'data.frame') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(residencetime = revisitation$residenceTime) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, color = residencetime)) + 
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_viridis() +
  labs(x = '', y = '', color = "Residence time (h)")
plot(g1)
plot(g2)

```

### 1.2.2 Analysis based on adehabitatLT

ltraj object was extracted for individual n

```{r}
mov.ind <- gps.data.ltraj[c(n)]
```

Creation of a graph representing the speed of the individual through time.

```{r}
print(summary(mov.ind)$id)
plotltr(gps.data.ltraj[c(n)])
```

Calculate residence time represented in a graph where the highest peak represents the calving.

```{r}
res1 <- residenceTime(mov.ind, radius = radius, maxt = 1, addinfo = T, units = "hour")
plot(residenceTime(mov.ind, radius = 200, maxt = 1, units = "hour"))

```

Creation of clusters to determine the calving period

First, the function "lavielle" performs segmentation of a time series

```{r}

segmentation <- adehabitatLT::lavielle(res1, which = "RT.200", Kmax = 20, Lmin = 2)

```

Then, was estimated the number of segments using a graph where k is the number of groups and Jk is the number of positions per group.

```{r}
chooseseg(segmentation)
```

The number of cluster define the variable r

```{r}
r<-7 # the value of r depends on the results above
```

A new graph was then generated with the limits of the segments given the number of defined segments.

```{r}
pa <- findpath(segmentation, r)
```

The segment with the longest residence time so the highest peak is extracted and corresponds to the variable l.

```{r}
l<-2 #the value of l depends on the results above
```

The selected segment is transformed into a data frame

```{r}
df <- ld(pa[c(l)]) 
```

Calculate the mean position between the beginning and date

```{r}
x <- mean(df$x)
y <- mean(df$y)

```

The id, the beginning and the end date were extracted from the data frame df

```{r}
id <- as.character(df$id[1])
date1  <- df$date[1]
date2  <- df$date[nrow(df)]

```

Creation of a new data frame

```{r}
#df1<-df1[1,]
df1 <- data.frame(x, y, id, date1, date2, year = lubridate::year(date1))
```

Calving site displayed in the trajectory graphs

```{r}
plot(mov.ind)
points(df1$x, df1$y, col = "purple", pch = 20, cex = 2)

g3 <- g2 + 
  geom_point(data = df1, aes(x, y), col = "purple")
g3
g2


```

After analysis, the column notes could be filled

```{r}
notes<-c("ok")
```

## 1.3 Editing data

Update the general table

```{r}
df1<-cbind(df1, notes)
df1


calving_candidates <- rbind(calving_candidates, df1)

```

Save the table outside R :

```{r}
write.csv(calving_candidates, "results/CSV/calving_period.csv", row.names = T)

```

Start again with n= n+1 then n= n+2 until n= length(data)

"calving_period" was renamed as "calving_period_dates" and imported into data file

# 3. Resource selection function (RSF)

## 3.1 Initialization before analysis

### 3.1.1 Load data

The csv file with the "TRUE" calving sites was loaded and missing data removed

```{r}
calv<-read.csv("data/CSV/calving_period_dates.csv")
calv<-na.omit(calv)
View(calv)
```


#### Define the area of possible calving sites


##### Calculation of the maximum distance : How far a reindeer can go ?


###### Calculate the minimum convex polygon (MCP)
 
 
Load the calving area where the water was removed on QGIS

```{r}
calvsites<-st_read("data/Area/without_water.shp")%>% 
  sf::st_transform(crs =CRS("+init=epsg:3006"))
coordinates(calv) <- c("x", "y")
```

MCP calculation 
```{r}
gps.mcp<- mcp(calv, percent =100)
plot(calv, pch = 16)
plot(gps.mcp, col = alpha (1:5, 0.5), add = TRUE)

plot(gps.mcp, col = alpha (1:5, 0.5))
plot(calvsites,add = TRUE)

hrs <- mcp.area(calv, percent = seq(50, 100, by = 5))
hrs
#196413.29	
#stable home range size
 
```

convert in shp file
```{r}
writeOGR(calv, "data/shp/calv.sp", "calving", driver = "ESRI Shapefile")
writeOGR(gps.mcp, "data/shp/calv.sp", "MCP", driver = "ESRI Shapefile")
```


On QGIS select the calving sites at the border of the MCP layer
Load those point on R

```{r}

MCP<- read.csv("data/CSV/MCPcorners.csv")

corners<-MCP$id
MCP.net<-data[data$id == corners,]


```


Calculate the net square displacement and redefine the ltraj for this new data with few points
```{r}

gps.data.ltraj2 <- as.ltraj(xy = MCP.net[, c("x", "y")], date = MCP.net$timestamp, 
                           id = MCP.net$id, burst = MCP.net$id, 
                           proj4string = CRS("+init=epsg:3006"))



```


Create a new column for the first individual with the net square displacement :

```{r}
net2<- sqrt(gps.data.ltraj2[[1]]$R2)
gps.net2.ltraj<- as.data.frame(cbind(gps.data.ltraj2[[1]],net2))

```

Same for the whole data set :

```{r}
for (n in 2:length(gps.data.ltraj2)) 
{net2 <- sqrt(gps.data.ltraj2[[n]]$R2)
  gps.net2.ltraj<- data.frame(rbind(cbind(gps.data.ltraj2[[n]],net2),gps.net2.ltraj))

}




```

On QGIS create a buffer with the mean net square displacement as the diameter

```{r}
mean( gps.net2.ltraj$net2)/2
```

On QGIS cut the calving area to obtain the available area. 
Load this area of possible calving sites and transform it in the right EPSG.

```{r}
calvsites<-st_read("data/Area/MCPnetsquare.shp")%>% 
  sf::st_transform(crs =CRS("+init=epsg:3006"))
plot(calvsites)
```



### 3.1.2 Edit Data

Define the different period thanks to a table with yearly calving period details

First load and re-code the file

```{r}
details_years <- read.csv("data/CSV/details_snow_free_mala_clean.csv", stringsAsFactors = F) %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(phase = factor(construction) %>% 
                  forcats::fct_relevel("after", after = Inf) %>% 
                  forcats::fct_recode("Before construction" = "before",
                                      "Construction" = "during",
                                      "Operation" = "after")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(year, phase)
details_years$phase

```

Then merge this file with the table corresponding to the calving dates

```{r}
calv<-read.csv("data/CSV/calving_period_dates.csv")
calv<-na.omit(calv)
calv <- calv%>% 
  dplyr::left_join(details_years, by = "year")

```

Define the right EPSG for the calving positions in the calving dates´ table

```{r}
calving <- calv %>% 
  amt::mk_track(.x = x, .y = y, year,phase, id, crs = "epsg:3006")
plot(calving)

calv$x<-calving$x_
calv$y<-calving$y_
```

The variables were loaded and rasterized

```{r}
# maps_files <- list.files("data/covariates/rsf_issf_final", pattern = ".tif$", full.names = T)
maps_files <- list.files("../../maps/", pattern = ".tif$", full.names = T)

# standardize wind turbine variables
f <- grep(pattern = "wind_turbines_bin", maps_files, value = TRUE)
maps_w <- terra::rast(f)
names(maps_w)
names(maps_w)[c(4,7)] <- gsub(pattern = "influence", replacement = "wind_turbines_bin_zoi", 
                            x = names(maps)[c(4,7)])
names(maps_w)[c(14,17,20)] <- gsub(pattern = "turbines nearest ZOI", 
                                 replacement = "wind_turbines_bin_zoi_nearest_exp_decay",
                                 x = names(maps)[c(14,17,20)])
names(maps_w)[10] <- "wind_turbines_bin_zoi_cumulative_exp_decay7500"

# extract
maps <- terra::rast(grep(pattern = "wind_turbines_bin", maps_files, value = TRUE, invert = TRUE))
maps <- c(maps, maps_w)
names(maps)
# maps_rast <- raster::stack(maps_files)

# keep only maps that we are going to use
omit <- c("bear", "building", "house_bin", "landcover_smd", "mining_all", "power_lines",
          "priv_road_bin", "public_road_bin", "railway", "sound", "trails", "urban",
          "wolf", "wolv")

maps_to_remove <- grep(paste0(omit, collapse = "|"), names(maps))
maps <- maps[[-maps_to_remove]]
maps
names(maps)
```

TPI as category

calculate SD of TPI using random points

```{r}

#############

SD <- apply(rand_back, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

data_ready_calving_rsf_inds<- 
data_ready_calving_rsf_nam |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    tpi_cat_s150m = case_when(
      tpi_s150m <= -SD[1] ~ "valley",
      tpi_s150m > -SD[1] & tpi_s150m <= -SD[1]/2  ~ "lower slope",
      tpi_s150m > -SD[1]/2 & tpi_s150m <= 0  ~ "flat area",
      tpi_s150m > 0 & tpi_s150m <= SD[1]/2  ~ "medium slope",
      tpi_s150m > SD[1]/2 & tpi_s150m <= SD[1]  ~ "upper slope",
      TRUE ~ "ridge"
    ),
    tpi_cat_s250m = case_when(
      tpi_s250m <= -SD[2] ~ "valley",
      tpi_s250m > -SD[2] & tpi_s250m <= -SD[2]/2  ~ "lower slope",
      tpi_s250m > -SD[2]/2 & tpi_s250m <= 0  ~ "flat area",
      tpi_s250m > 0 & tpi_s250m <= SD[2]/2  ~ "medium slope",
      tpi_s250m > SD[2]/2 & tpi_s250m <= SD[2]  ~ "upper slope",
      TRUE ~ "ridge"
    ),
    tpi_cat_s510m = case_when(
      tpi_s510m <= -SD[3] ~ "valley",
      tpi_s510m > -SD[3] & tpi_s510m <= -SD[3]/2  ~ "lower slope",
      tpi_s510m > -SD[3]/2 & tpi_s510m <= 0  ~ "flat area",
      tpi_s510m > 0 & tpi_s510m <= SD[3]/2  ~ "medium slope",
      tpi_s510m > SD[3]/2 & tpi_s510m <= SD[3]  ~ "upper slope",
      TRUE ~ "ridge"
    )
  )


```

```{r}

data_ready_calving_rsf_wf$wf_name
```

```{r}
colnames(data_ready_calving_rsf )
```

## 3.2 RSF process

### 3.2.1 GLM, no threshold regression

Add a weight

```{r}
data_ready_calving_rsf_2h$w_obs <- ifelse(data_ready_calving_rsf_2h$case_, 1, 5000)

data_ready_calving_rsf_2h$case_ <- ifelse(data_ready_calving_rsf_2h$case_ == TRUE, 1, 0)
```

Wind turbines distances

```{r}
summary(data_ready_calving_rsf_2h$wind_turbines_dist_comb)
```

##### GLM

##### GLM, no threshold regression, using ZoI for wind power and mining

```{r}
base_formula <- case_ ~ scale(dem) + I(scale(dem)^2) + scale(slope) + cos_aspect + 
  scale(sos) + 
  log(power_lines_dist+1) + log(priv_road_dist+1) + log(public_road_dist+1) + 
  log(trails_dist+1) + 
  log(house_dist+1) + scale(mining_Krist_nearestXXX) +
  wf_name + landcover*phase*scale(wind_turbines_ZZZ)

scals <- c(100, 250, 500, 1000,2000, 2500,3000, 5000, 7500, 10000)
zois <- c("nearest", "cumulative")
wind_scals <- paste0(rep(zois, each = length(scals)), rep(scals, length(zois)))
tpi_scals <- c("tpi_cat_s150m", "tpi_cat_s250m", "tpi_cat_s510m")
lc_var <- c("landcover", "viewshed_lc")

# n models = 7*2*14*3*2 = 1176
```

# using land cover


```{r}
fits <- tibble::tibble(mining = numeric(), wind = character(), 
                       tpi = character(), lc = character(), 
                       aic = numeric())
#models <- list()
counter <- 1
for(i in scals) {
  for(j in wind_scals) {
  for(tt in tpi_scals) {
  for(lc in lc_var) {
    updt <- paste0("~ . - scale(mining_Krist_nearestXXX) - ",
                   "landcover*phase*scale(wind_turbines_ZZZ) + ", 
                   tt, " + ",
                   paste0("scale(mining_Krist_nearest", i, ") + "),
                   paste0(lc, "*phase*scale(wind_turbines_", j, ")"))
    form <- update(base_formula, updt)
    
    print(paste0("mines = ", i, "; wind = ", j, "; tpi = ", tt, 
                 "; lc = ", lc, " up and running..."))
    fit1 <- glm(form, 
                data = data_ready_calving_rsf_2h, #weights = w_obs,
                family = binomial(link = "logit"))
    fits[counter,1] <- i
    fits[counter,2] <- j
    fits[counter,3] <- tt
    fits[counter,4] <- lc
    fits[counter,5] <- AIC(fit1)
    
    counter <- counter+1
  }}}
}

save(fits, file = "results/calving_multi_zoi_table.rda")
load("results/calving_multi_zoi_table.rda")
fits
fits[which.min(fits$aic),]
```

```{r}
w3 <- ifelse(w > log(3000), w - log(3000), 0)
w4 <- ifelse(w > log(4000), w - log(4000), 0)
w5 <- ifelse(w > log(5000), w - log(5000), 0)
w6 <- ifelse(w > log(6000), w - log(6000), 0)
w7 <- ifelse(w > log(8000), w - log(8000), 0)
w8 <- ifelse(w > log(10000), w - log(10000), 0)
w9 <- ifelse(w > log(15000), w - log(15000), 0)
```


define interaction with phase for thresholds for distance to the nearest wind turbine
```{r}
p <- data_ready_calving_rsf_2h$phase
p1 <- ifelse(data_ready_calving_rsf_2h$phase == "Construction", 1, 0)
p2 <- ifelse(data_ready_calving_rsf_2h$phase == "Operation", 1, 0)
wp1 <- w*p1
wp2 <- w*p2
w1p1 <- w1*p1
w1p2 <- w1*p2
w2p1 <- w2*p1
w2p2 <- w2*p2
w3p1 <- w3*p1
w3p2 <- w3*p2
w4p1 <- w4*p1
w4p2 <- w4*p2
w5p1 <- w5*p1
w5p2 <- w5*p2
w6p1 <- w6*p1
w6p2 <- w6*p2
w7p1 <- w7*p1
w7p2 <- w7*p2
w8p1 <- w8*p1
w8p2 <- w8*p2
w9p1 <- w9*p1
w9p2 <- w9*p2
```


# formula

```{r}

formula_calving <- case_ ~ scale(dem) + I(scale(dem)^2) + scale(slope) + cos_aspect + 
  scale(sos) + 
  log(power_lines_dist+1) + log(priv_road_dist+1) + log(public_road_dist+1) + log(mining_dist_Krist+1) +
  log(trails_dist+1) + log(house_dist+1) + 
  landcover*phase*wind_turbines + wf_name

formula_calving <- case_ ~ scale(dem) + I(scale(dem)^2) + scale(slope) + cos_aspect + 
  scale(sos) + 
  log(power_lines_dist+1) + log(priv_road_dist+1) + log(public_road_dist+1) + log(mining_dist_Krist+1) +
  log(trails_dist+1) + log(house_dist+1) +
  landcover + phase + wf_name
```

```{r}
head(M)

```

```{r}
X <- cbind(M, w, w1, w2, w3, w4, w5, w6, w7, w8, w9,

           w5p1, w5p2, w6p1, w6p2, w7p1, w7p2, w8p1, w8p2, w9p1, w9p2)
```


# 4 IRG 

## 4.1 Load and edit data 

### 4.1.1 Load data

Load NDVI raster files
```{r}

r <- list.files("data/IRGcalc", pattern = ".tif$", full.names = T)

```

Load calving sites
```{r}
calv<-read.csv("data/CSV/calving_period_dates.csv")
```

Remove the missing data and unnecessary columns
```{r}
calv<-na.omit(calv)
calv<-calv[,-6]#unnecessary column
```

#### Reprojection

Reprojection of the TRUE calving sites

```{r}
calving <- calv %>% 
  amt::mk_track(.x = x, .y = y,year,id,X,date_begin,crs = "epsg:3006")
plot(calving)

sites <-st_as_sf(calving,coords = 1:2)%>% 
  terra::vect()
plot(sites)
data<-as.data.frame(sites)
sites$X<-1:171
```

Reprojection of the NDVI data if needed
```{r}
#for (n in 1:6){s<-terra :: project(rast(r[[n]]), "epsg:3006")
#writeRaster(s,filename = r[[n]], overwrite = TRUE )}



```
#### Extraction of the NDVI at each calving sites during the calving 

##### Create a table with the NDVI of each calving site during calving

For the first calving site

```{r}
g <- list.files("data/IRGcalc", pattern = ".tif$", full.names = T)
g <-rast(g)

df1<- extract(g[[as.character(as.Date(sites[sites$X == 1,]$date_begin))]], sites[sites$X == 1,])
df1<-cbind(sites[sites$X == 1,]$id,df1)
names(df1)<-c("ID", "...","NDVI")
ndvi <- df1

```

Loop for all the calving sites
```{r}
for (z in 2:171) 
{df1<- extract(g[[as.character(as.Date(sites[sites$X == z,]$date_begin))]], sites[sites$X == z,])
df1<-cbind(sites[sites$X == z,]$id,df1)
names(df1)<-c("ID", "...","NDVI")
ndvi <- rbind(ndvi, df1)}
ndvi<-ndvi[,-2]
NDVItable<-merge(calv, ndvi, by.x ="id", by.y ="ID")

write.csv(NDVItable,"results/NDVI/NDVI.csv",row.names = FALSE )
```




Extract the NDVI of each days during the calving period

```{r}

r <- list.files("data/IRGcalc", pattern = ".tif$", full.names = T)
r<-rast(r)


NDVI2008<- r[[c(as.character(seq(as.Date("2008-05-01"), as.Date("2008-06-30"), 1)))]]
NDVI2009<- r[[c(as.character(seq(as.Date("2009-05-01"), as.Date("2009-06-30"), 1)))]]
NDVI2010<- r[[c(as.character(seq(as.Date("2010-05-01"), as.Date("2010-06-30"), 1)))]]
NDVI2011<- r[[c(as.character(seq(as.Date("2011-05-01"), as.Date("2011-06-30"), 1)))]]
NDVI2015<- r[[c(as.character(seq(as.Date("2015-05-01"), as.Date("2015-06-30"), 1)))]]
NDVI2016<- r[[c(as.character(seq(as.Date("2016-05-01"), as.Date("2016-06-30"), 1)))]]

```


Create raster files of NDVI each day during calving season of each year

## 4.2 Calculate IRG 

### 4.2.1 In 2008
 
Calculate IRG for each date of the first site :

```{r}
ndvi08<-read.csv("results/NDVI/IRG/CSV/NDVI2008.csv")%>%
  relocate(Name, .after = X2008.06.30 )
ndvi08<-ndvi08[,-1]
colnames(ndvi08)<-nam2008
colnames(ndvi08)[62]<- "Name"

s<-sum(ndvi08[1,1+1],- ndvi08[1,1])
res<-s

```



Extract the maximum IRG corresponding to the peak of greenup 

```{r}
ligne<- for (z in 2:60)
{s<-sum(ndvi08[1,z+1],-ndvi08[1,z])
res<-c(res,s)}
maxi<-colnames(ndvi08[which.max(res)])
IRG<-cbind(ndvi08[1,62],maxi)
greenup<-IRG

```

Calculate IRG for each date of each other sites and extract the maximum IRG corresponding to the peak of greenup for each sites

```{r}
for(n in 2 : length (ndvi08$Name))
{s<-sum(ndvi08[n,1+1],-ndvi08[n,1])
res<-s

ligne<- for (z in 2:60)
{s<-sum(ndvi08[n,z+1],-ndvi08[n,z])
res<-c(res,s)}
maxi<-colnames(ndvi08[which.max(res)])
IRG<-cbind(ndvi08[n,62],maxi)
greenup<-rbind(greenup,IRG)}
colnames(greenup)<-c("Name", "max.IRG")



IRG2008<-merge(greenup,calv[,-c(1,5,6)], by.x = "Name", by.y = "id")
write.csv(IRG2008,"results/NDVI/IRG/CSV/IRG2008.csv",row.names = FALSE )
IRG2008<-read.csv("results/NDVI/IRG/CSV/IRG2008.csv")

```

Calculate difference between peak of IRG and calving date for each site

```{r}
ph<-as.Date(IRG2008$date_begin[1])-as.Date(IRG2008$`max.IRG`[1])
dif<-ph
for(i in 2:length(IRG2008$Name))
{ph<-as.Date(IRG2008$date_begin[i])-as.Date(IRG2008$`max.IRG`[i])
dif<-c(dif, ph)}
IRG2008$difIRG<-dif
MOY2008<-mean(IRG2008$difIRG)
```

## 4.3 IRG analysis


### For each phase were calculated :

#### - The minimum and the maximum number of days from greenup (the number of days before greenup the first reindeer calved and the number of days after the greenup the last reindeer calved )


```{r}

IRGbefore <- rbind(IRG2008,IRG2009)
IRGduring <- rbind(IRG2010,IRG2011)
IRGafter <-rbind(IRG2015,IRG2016)

minbefore<-min(IRGbefore$difIRG)
maxbefore<-max(IRGbefore$difIRG)


minduring<-min(IRGduring$difIRG)
maxduring<-max(IRGduring$difIRG)


minafter<-min(IRGafter$difIRG)
maxafter<-max(IRGafter$difIRG)

phase<-c("before", "during", "after")

min_per_phase<-c(minbefore, minduring, minafter)
names(min_per_phase)<-phase
min_per_phase

```


```{r}
max_per_phase<-c(maxbefore, maxduring, maxafter)
names(max_per_phase)<-phase
max_per_phase

```


#### - The mean number of days from the peak of IRG 
```{r}

moy_per_yr<-c(MOY2008,MOY2009,MOY2010,MOY2011,MOY2015,MOY2016)
names(moy_per_yr)<-c("2008","2009","2010","2011","2015","2016")

IRGbefore<-rbind(IRG2008,IRG2009)
Moybefore<-mean(IRGbefore$difIRG)


IRGduring<-rbind(IRG2010,IRG2011)
Moyduring<-mean(IRGduring$difIRG)

IRGafter<-rbind(IRG2015,IRG2016)
Moyafter<-mean(IRGafter$difIRG)

moy_per_phase<-c(Moybefore, Moyduring, Moyafter)
names(moy_per_phase)<-c("before", "during", "after")
moy_per_phase
```

######  The average days from green-up were compared.
###### Test of the anova hypothesis

Prepare data with phase and number of days from greenup

```{r}
IRGbefore$phase <- "before"
IRGafter$phase <- "after"
IRGduring$phase<- "during"


bef<-cbind(IRGbefore$phase,IRGbefore$difIRG)
aft<-cbind(IRGafter$phase,IRGafter$difIRG)
dur<-cbind(IRGduring$phase,IRGduring$difIRG)
table<- rbind(bef,aft,dur)
colnames(table)<- c("ph","difIRG")
table<-as.data.frame(table)
table$difIRG<- as.numeric(table$difIRG)
table$ph <- as.factor(table$ph)


```

- Homoscedasticity
```{r}
bartlett.test(table$difIRG~table$ph)
# homoscedasticity rejected
# = diff variance
```
- Normality (not necessary since homoscedasticity rejected)

```{r}
bef<-table[table$ph == "before",]$difIRG
aft <- table[table$ph == "after",]$difIRG
dur<- table[table$ph == "during",]$difIRG

shapiro.test(bef)#0.27
shapiro.test(aft)#0.05
shapiro.test(dur)#0.09


hist(bef)
hist(aft)
hist(dur)
#Normality

```
###### Use the Kruskal-Wallis Test

Hypothesis

- Ordinal response variable
- Independence
- Similar shapes

```{r}
plot(bef)
plot(aft)
plot(dur)

```

Test 
```{r}
kruskal.test( difIRG ~ ph, data = table)
#Significant differences between groups

```
- Pairwise comparison between groups 
```{r}
pairwise.wilcox.test(table$difIRG, table$ph,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")
#Significant differences with construction phase
```

#### - The percentage of calving occurring after the Greenup 

```{r}
posbefore<-(length(IRGbefore$difIRG[(0<IRGbefore$difIRG)])/length(IRGbefore$difIRG))*100
posduring<-(length(IRGduring$difIRG[(0<IRGduring$difIRG)])/length(IRGduring$difIRG))*100
posafter<-(length(IRGafter$difIRG[(0<IRGafter$difIRG)])/length(IRGafter$difIRG))*100


calv_after_per_phase<-c(posbefore, posduring,posafter)
names(calv_after_per_phase)<-phase
calv_after_per_phase
```


#### - The percentage of calving occurring exactly during the Greenup

```{r}


eqbefore<-(length(IRGbefore$difIRG[IRGbefore$difIRG == 0])/length(IRGbefore$difIRG))*100
eqduring<-(length(IRGduring$difIRG[IRGduring$difIRG == 0])/length(IRGduring$difIRG))*100
eqafter<-(length(IRGafter$difIRG[IRGafter$difIRG== 0])/length(IRGafter$difIRG))*100
calv_during_per_phase<-c(eqbefore, eqduring,eqafter)
names(calv_during_per_phase)<-phase
calv_during_per_phase

```

### 3.1.4 Edit Data file



The variables were loaded and rasterized

```{r}
maps_files <- list.files("data/covariates/Factors", pattern = ".tif$", full.names = T)

maps<- terra::rast(maps_files)

maps_rast <- raster::stack(maps_files)

```


Load explanation of the class codes

```{r}
lc_class <- read.csv("data/CSV/nmd_classes_eng_reclassified.csv", header = F, 
                     col.names = c("code", "class"), stringsAsFactors = F) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(code)
```

re-classify the land cover into five classes

```{r}
open<-rbind(lc_class[lc_class$code == 2,], lc_class[lc_class$code == 3,],lc_class[lc_class$code == 41,],lc_class[lc_class$code == 201,],lc_class[lc_class$code == 202,])
anthropo<-lc_class[lc_class$code == 51,]
water<-lc_class[lc_class$code == 61,]
forest<- rbind(lc_class[lc_class$code == 111,], lc_class[lc_class$code == 112,],lc_class[lc_class$code == 114,],lc_class[lc_class$code == 121,])
clearcut<-lc_class[lc_class$code == 118,]
open$classb<-"Open areas"
anthropo$classb<-"Anthropogenic areas"
water$classb<-"Water"
forest$classb<-"Forest lands"
clearcut$classb<-"Clearcuts"
lc_class<-rbind(open, anthropo, water, forest, clearcut)
```

Extraction of those new points from the map

```{r}
c_rand<-rbind(c_rand2008,c_rand2009,c_rand2010,c_rand2011,c_rand2015,c_rand2016)

rand_back <- terra::extract(maps, c_rand) %>%
  as.data.frame()
View(rand_back)

```


Creation of a data frame with the values of the variables tested for each random points and "TRUE" ones

```{r}

Data.RSF<-cbind(rando,rand_back)%>% 
  dplyr::mutate(landcover = factor(landcover_nmd_mod, 
                                   levels = lc_class$code,
                                   labels = lc_class$classb))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(landcover_nmd_mod = factor(landcover_nmd_mod, 
                                           levels = lc_class$code,
                                           labels = lc_class$class))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(phase = factor(year, 
                               levels = phaset$code,
                               labels = phaset$class))%>%
  relocate(ID, .before = case_)%>%
  relocate(case_, .before = year)%>%
  relocate(phase, .after = year)%>%
  relocate(landcover_nmd_mod, .after = landcover)%>%
  rename(Used = case_, x=x_, y=y_, elevation = dem_10m, landcover_nmd = landcover_nmd_mod, mine = mining_dist, powerline = pl_dist, private_road = priv_road_dist, public_road = public_road_dist, windfarm = wind_dist, turbines_density1000 = influence_cumulative_exp_decay1000, turbines_density2000 = influence_cumulative_exp_decay2000, turbines_density3000 = influence_cumulative_exp_decay3000,  turbines_density5000 = influence_cumulative_exp_decay5000, turbines_density7500 = wind_turbines_rast_bin_50_zoi_cumulative_bartlett7500_interp10, turbines_nearest1000 = "turbines nearest ZOI1000",turbines_nearest2000 = "turbines nearest ZOI2000",turbines_nearest3000 = "turbines nearest ZOI3000",turbines_nearest5000 = "turbines nearest ZOI5000",turbines_nearest7500 = "turbines nearest ZOI7500",mines_nearest1000 = "mines nearest ZOI1000",mines_nearest2000 = "mines nearest ZOI2000",mines_nearest3000 = "mines nearest ZOI3000",mines_nearest5000 = "mines nearest ZOI5000",mines_nearest7500 = "mines nearest ZOI7500")%>%
relocate(turbines_density7500, .after = turbines_density5000)



```

### 3.1.5 Calculation of the mean NDVI


Define the right EPSG for the available calving positions just defined


```{r}
Data.RSF$year<-as.numeric(Data.RSF$year)
calvin <- Data.RSF%>% 
  amt::mk_track(.x = x, .y = y,year,ID,crs = "epsg:3006")
plot(calvin)

Data.RSF$x<-calvin$x_
Data.RSF$y<-calvin$y_

sites <-st_as_sf(calvin,coords = 1:2)%>% 
  terra::vect()
plot(sites)

```


Creation of two columns in "Data.RSF" with the different NDVI calculations´ methods (Elmore and Beck)

```{r}

elmore<-list.files("data/covariates/NDVI/elmore", pattern = ".tif$", full.names = T)
elmore<-rast(elmore)


df1<- extract(elmore[[1]], sites[sites$t_ == yr[[1]]])
df1<-cbind(sites[sites$t_ == yr[[1]]]$ID,yr[[1]],df1)
names(df1)<-c("ID","year","X","elmore")
elmoresum <- df1


for (z in 2:6) 
{df1<- extract(elmore[[z]], sites[sites$t_ == yr[[z]]])
df1<-cbind(sites[sites$t_ == yr[[z]]]$ID,yr[[z]],df1)
names(df1)<-c("ID","year","X","elmore")
elmoresum <- rbind(elmoresum, df1)}
elmoresum<-elmoresum[,-3]


beck<-list.files("data/covariates/NDVI/beck", pattern = ".tif$", full.names = T)
beck<-rast(beck)

df1<- extract(beck[[1]], sites[sites$t_ == yr[[1]]])
df1<-cbind(sites[sites$t_ == yr[[1]]]$ID,yr[[1]],df1)
names(df1)<-c("ID","year","X","beck")
becksum <- df1

for (z in 2:6) 
{df1<- extract(beck[[z]], sites[sites$t_ == yr[[z]]])
df1<-cbind(sites[sites$t_ == yr[[z]]]$ID,yr[[z]],df1)
names(df1)<-c("ID","year","X","beck")
becksum <- rbind(becksum, df1)}
becksum<-becksum[,-3]

summy<-merge(elmoresum,becksum, by = c("ID","year"))
summy<-as.data.frame(summy)


```

Creation of the column with the average of the two calculations´ methods (Elmore and Beck) which corresponds to the NDVI of the analysis

```{r}

df1<-mean(c(summy$elmore[[1]],summy$beck[[1]]))
df1<-cbind(summy[1,],df1)
names(df1)<-c("ID","year","elmore", "beck","mean")
moy<-df1

for (z in 2:1881){df1<-mean(c(summy$elmore[[z]],summy$beck[[z]]))
df1<-cbind(summy[z,],df1)
names(df1)<-c("ID","year","elmore", "beck","mean")
moy<-rbind(moy,df1)}

rand_background<-merge(Data.RSF, moy, by= c("ID","year"))

Data.RSF<-rand_background%>% 
  rename(NDVI = mean)%>%
  relocate(elevation, .after = phase)

write.csv(Data.RSF, "results/CSV/DataRSF.csv", row.names= FALSE)

```

## 3.2 RSF process

### 3.2.1 Preparation of the data

```{r}
Data.RSF<-read.csv("results/CSV/DataRSF.csv", sep = ",", dec= ".")

```


```{r}

Data.rsf.full<- Data.RSF 

Data.rsf.full<-na.omit(Data.rsf.full)
nrow(Data.rsf.full)
View(Data.rsf.full)
```

Categorical variables were converted into factors:

```{r}
Data.rsf.full$year<-as.factor(Data.rsf.full$year)

```

Calculation of the square elevation ( because it is a continue variable) and log distances (because the infrastructure is supposed to have a stronger influence when it is closer to the site)

```{r}
Data.rsf.full$logPublic_road<-log(Data.rsf.full$public_road+1)
Data.rsf.full$logPrivate_road<-log(Data.rsf.full$private_road+1)
Data.rsf.full$logwindfarm<- log(Data.rsf.full$windfarm+1)
Data.rsf.full$logmine<-log(Data.rsf.full$mine+1)
Data.rsf.full$logpowerline<-log(Data.rsf.full$powerline+1)
Data.rsf.full$elevation2<-Data.rsf.full$elevation^2

```

Add a stronger weight to the FALSE calving sites
```{r}
Data.rsf.full$w <- ifelse(Data.rsf.full$Used== TRUE, 1, 5000)
Data.rsf.full<-relocate (Data.rsf.full, w, .after = Used)
```

### 3.2.1 Influence of the closest wind farm

Selection of the column needed in the analysis

```{r}
colnames(Data.rsf.full)
Data.rsf<- Data.rsf.full[,c(1:8,29,33:39)]
```

Calculation of the dependence among the different variables

```{r}
ggpairs(Data.rsf, columns = c("elevation", "logPublic_road", "elevation2", "logPrivate_road", "logmine", "landcover", "phase", "logpowerline", "NDVI", "logwindfarm"))
#no dependence 
```

Selection of the best model

```{r}

RSF.fit <-  glm(Used~TRUE+scale(elevation) + scale(elevation2) + logPublic_road + logPrivate_road + logmine + logpowerline + scale(NDVI)+ landcover + logwindfarm * phase, family = "binomial", data = Data.rsf, weights = w)
summary(RSF.fit)#AIC = 3957

RSF.fit2 <-  glm(Used~TRUE+scale(elevation) + scale(elevation2) + logPublic_road + logPrivate_road + logmine + logpowerline + landcover + logwindfarm*phase, family = "binomial", data = Data.rsf, weights = w)
summary(RSF.fit2)#AIC = 3956.5

RSF.fit3 <-  glm(Used~TRUE+scale(elevation) + scale(elevation2) + logPublic_road + logPrivate_road + logmine + logpowerline + logwindfarm + landcover, family = "binomial", data = Data.rsf, weights = w)
summary(RSF.fit3)#AIC = 3949 


RSF.fit4<-  glm(Used~TRUE+scale(elevation) + scale(elevation2) + logPublic_road + logPrivate_road + logmine + logpowerline + scale(NDVI) +logwindfarm, family = "binomial", data = Data.rsf, weights = w)
summary(RSF.fit4)#AIC = 3974worst

RSF.fit5 <-  glm(Used~TRUE+scale(elevation) + scale(elevation2) + logPublic_road + logPrivate_road + logmine + logpowerline + logwindfarm*phase + landcover, family = "binomial", data = Data.rsf, weights = w)
summary(RSF.fit5)#3956.5

RSF.fit6 <-  glm(Used~TRUE+scale(elevation) + scale(elevation2) + logPublic_road + logPrivate_road + logmine + logpowerline + logwindfarm*phase + scale(NDVI), family = "binomial", data = Data.rsf, weights = w)
summary(RSF.fit6)#3980

drop1(RSF.fit, test ="Chi")
drop1(RSF.fit2, test ="Chi")
drop1(RSF.fit3, test ="Chi")#keep RSF.fit3
drop1(RSF.fit4, test ="Chi")
drop1(RSF.fit5, test ="Chi")
drop1(RSF.fit6, test ="Chi")
```

Verification of the other assumptions:

-   Homoscedasticity

```{r}

bartlett.test(resid(RSF.fit3), Data.rsf$Used)#To verify homogeneity 

#p_value > 0.05 =  Homoscedasticity not rejected


```

-   Normalization

```{r}
par(mfrow=(c(2,2)))
pl<-function(n)
{plot(Data.rsf[,n],resid(RSF.fit3), xlab = colnames(Data.rsf[n]), ylab = "Residuals")}
sapply(c(8,10:16),pl)
#Normalized

dev.off()
```

# 4 Results analysis 

## 4.1 Choice of the best model in each cathegory


```{r}
summary(ZOI1000)#3968.4
summary(ZOI2000)#3960.7
summary(ZOI3000)#3963.5
summary(ZOI5000)#3962.6
summary(ZOI7500)#3970.7


drop1(ZOI2000, test ="Chi")
drop1(ZOI3000, test ="Chi")

#ZOI2000 best model


summary(turb1000)#3962.3 
summary(turb2000)#3963
summary(turb3000)#3963.7
summary(turb5000)#3965
summary(turb7500)#3967.2


drop1(turb1000, test ="Chi")#the nearest turbines influence with a zoi of 1km

#Best model turb 1000

summary(min1000)#3963.6 #with or without NDVI
summary(min2000)#3952.6
summary(min3000)#3951.5
summary(min5000)#3948
summary(min7500)#3942.6 #with or without NDVI

drop1(min7500, test = "Chi")#the nearest mines influence with a zoi of 7.5 km (at least)


#AIC with ZOI 7500 very low

#The mines influence on a larger area than the wind farms 

```

To determine the factors influencing the calving site location, were tested in the last model the zone of influence of the turbines and the zone of influence of the mine using the ZOI of the three best models from the mine and the turbine in turn.

```{r}

RSF.Best1<-  glm(Used~TRUE+scale(elevation) + scale(elevation2) + logPublic_road + logPrivate_road + landcover+ turbines_density2000*phase+mines_nearest7500, family = "binomial", data = Data.rsf.full, weights = w)
```
